svg.title: Pedro Vygotsky developer profile
svg.desc: About Pedro Vygotsky, selected technologies and tools, and network channels. Interactive destinations are provided in the README link index because this SVG is rendered as an image on GitHub.
svg.text: Hello, my name is Pedro. I'm a software developer with over three years of experience,
focusing on front-end development while continuously expanding my skills across the full-
I am currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and dedicate much of my time
to programming, studying, and building new projects.
I am passionate about technology and education; outside of development, I also have a keen
interest in fitness, cinema, and music.
